name: POS
recent: Pos Malaysia 在 2026 年 11 月 19 日宣布，其间接全资子公司 PNSL 拟以 1290 万美元（约 5270 万令吉）现金将一艘名为 MV POS Logistics 1 的船舶出售给香港公司 WYW。此前，公司于 11 月 16 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，净亏损扩大至 6225 万令吉，但营收同比增长 8.3%。公司表示复苏取决于政府的邮政改革。
notable: 拟以 1290 万美元（约 5270 万令吉）出售船舶 MV POS Logistics 1 给香港公司 WYW。
2026 年第三季度净亏损扩大至 6225 万令吉，但营收同比增长 8.3%。
risks: 第三季度净亏损较上一季度扩大。
公司表示复苏取决于政府邮政改革。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 4.813 亿令吉，环比下降 4%，同比增长 9%；净亏损为 4346 万令吉，净亏损率为 9.0%，而上一季度净亏损率为 3.9%。

recent_en: On 19 November 2026, Pos Malaysia announced that its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary PNSL proposed to dispose of a marine vessel, MV POS Logistics 1, to Hong Kong firm WYW for USD12.9 million (approximately RM52.7 million) in cash. Earlier, on 16 November, the company reported a wider net loss of RM62.25 million for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, while revenue rose 8.3% year-on-year. The company said its recovery depends on government postal reforms.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of marine vessel MV POS Logistics 1 to Hong Kong firm WYW for USD12.9 million (approximately RM52.7 million).
Q3 2026 net loss widened to RM62.25 million, while revenue rose 8.3% year-on-year.
risks_en: Q3 net loss widened compared with the previous quarter.
The company said its recovery depends on government postal reforms.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM481.3 million, down 4% QoQ but up 9% YoY; net loss was RM43.46 million with a net margin of -9.0%, compared with -3.9% in the previous quarter.
